title: Ceramics Workshops
host_org: Snow Farm: The New England Craft Program
source_quote: This studio houses all ceramics workshops, including hand building, wheel throwing, alternative glazing and sculpture classes. The ceramics studio was fully renovated in 2019.
evidence_sentence: The Ceramics studio page states the outdoor kiln deck includes a raku kiln, Bailey gas kiln, and pit firing area.
evidence_quote: upgraded electricity for the outdoor kiln deck which includes a raku kiln, Bailey gas kiln, and pit firing area
summary: Snow Farm offers ceramics workshops using raku, gas reduction, and pit firing. Register through the workshops portal to find available classes and dates.
